job_title: Head of IT Operations / Technology Delivery (Insurance)
role_summary: Senior operational technology leader reporting to the COO, responsible for IT operations, application management, and service delivery across the insurance technology landscape. Drives execution of technology initiatives and regulatory change, ensures production stability and operational resilience, maintains technology governance/risk/compliance, and manages vendor-delivered services and budgets, while building high-performing teams.
must_have_requirements: 15+ years IT experience with leadership exposure in insurance/financial services
Proven experience in IT strategy, transformation, and governance
Bachelor's degree in IT or related discipline
ITIL, COBIT, TOGAF or equivalent IT governance/architecture certification
Deep understanding of insurance business operations (underwriting, policy admin, distribution, claims)
Strong knowledge of IT governance frameworks, technology risk management, and regulatory requirements (Insurance Authority, cybersecurity standards)
Extensive experience in IT operations, application management, and service delivery within financial services/insurance
Proven track record leading system implementation, modernization, or core platform transformation projects
Hands-on exposure to IT governance, audit, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance
Strong leadership managing large IT teams and complex transformation programs
Vendor management, contract negotiation, and third-party service oversight experience
Strong financial acumen managing IT budgets, cost optimization, investment prioritization
nice_to_have_requirements: Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and Agile/DevOps practices
Experience working with regional or global IT teams and cross-border delivery models
Enterprise architecture, data platforms, and system integration experience in financial services
Experience driving digital transformation in a regulated environment

scoring_criteria.name: Insurance IT Domain Expertise
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role requires deep understanding of insurance operations (policy, claims, underwriting, distribution) to manage applications effectively.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates from generic financial services may lack insurance-specific systems knowledge

scoring_criteria.name: IT Operations & Application Management Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core responsibility is owning end-to-end application management and ensuring production stability across business-critical systems.

scoring_criteria.name: IT Governance & Risk/Compliance Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Strong governance, risk, and regulatory compliance (Insurance Authority, audit) are explicit requirements.

scoring_criteria.name: Technology Delivery & Transformation Execution
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role demands disciplined execution of transformation, modernization, and regulatory change programs.

scoring_criteria.name: Vendor & Third-Party Service Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Managing outsourced providers and strategic vendors is central to service delivery accountability.

scoring_criteria.name: Cybersecurity & Operational Resilience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Oversight of cybersecurity, BCP/DR, and information security risk mitigation is a key accountability.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May be partial if candidate has governance but not hands-on security certs

scoring_criteria.name: Leadership & Team Development
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role requires building and leading large, high-performing IT teams with succession planning.

scoring_criteria.name: Financial & Budget Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Accountability for IT budgets, cost optimization, and resource planning.

scoring_criteria.name: Cloud & Modern Technology Familiarity
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Familiarity with cloud platforms and Agile/DevOps supports modernization efforts, though secondary to governance/operations focus.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Likely limited hands-on cloud experience given operations-heavy background

summary_focus: Position as senior IT operations/technology leader with insurance or financial services background
Highlight application management, production stability, and service delivery ownership
Emphasize governance, risk, and regulatory compliance track record
Showcase vendor management and budget/resource accountability
Quantify team size led and scale of technology portfolio managed
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim insurance-specific system expertise if experience is from unrelated financial services without insurance context
Do not overstate hands-on cybersecurity certification if not formally certified (CISSP/CISM)
Do not imply direct cloud architecture ownership if role was operational/governance-focused only
Avoid claiming core platform transformation leadership unless directly accountable for delivery outcomes

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position candidate as a seasoned IT operations and governance leader who bridges technology delivery with business and regulatory priorities in insurance/financial services, emphasizing stability, compliance, and measurable operational outcomes
bridge_gaps_honestly: If lacking direct insurance experience, emphasize transferable financial services regulatory and operational governance expertise
If no formal security certification, highlight practical experience overseeing cybersecurity and resilience programs
If cloud exposure is limited, focus on governance oversight of cloud initiatives rather than technical implementation
If vendor management experience is indirect, describe oversight through governance or program management roles
